purpose: Catch-all route recovery page explaining the unmatched pathname and offering suggested destinations and escape actions.
primaryGoal: Recover from an unknown URL by selecting a suggested page, returning to history, navigating to the dashboard, or opening the existing command palette.

dataSources.name: Router location and navigation
dataSources.detail: pathname drives the message and suggestions; pathname plus search drives the diagnostic effect. No page API request or SI measurement.

dataSources.name: Known route suggestions
dataSources.detail: Up to five suggestions from the generated registry; hidden entries excluded; minimum pathname/English-label Levenshtein distance at most six; sort by distance then path. Empty normalized query returns no suggestions.

dataSources.name: Localization and document title
dataSources.detail: Uses notFound.* and registry-provided route i18n keys with existing fallbacks. Title hook writes through titleStore and restores the previous base title on cleanup; catalogs and titleStore implementation not inspected.

dataSources.name: Browser recovery integration
dataSources.detail: window.history.length determines history.back versus navigate('/'); dashboard action navigates('/'); search dispatches toggle-command-palette. Palette listener and actual history destinations are unverified.

components.name: PageLayout
components.detail: Existing category-barrel adapter forwards PageContainer props and supplies a full-width min-w-0 container. PageContainer header source includes an h1 route-focus target.

components.name: GlassPanel
components.detail: One centered max-w-2xl recovery text/action block. Existing neutral panel tokens, print marker and forced-color classes; default glow none and hover false.

components.name: SectionTitle / Text / Caption
components.detail: Shared h2 section heading, body paragraph, suggestion-introduction paragraph and path captions. Existing role styling is retained.

components.name: Button
components.detail: Three labeled recovery actions; inherited md size and wrapLabel false. Shared focus tokens and native button semantics.

components.name: Link and semantic navigation list
components.detail: Localized route labels retain visible path metadata and native link semantics.

components.name: Compass / ArrowLeft / Home / Search
components.detail: All four icons explicitly hidden from assistive technology; visible translated text names the actions.

sourceEvidence.detail: Centered constrained text block with p-4 and sm:p-6; this is not an analytical full-width page.
Suggestions stack vertically; path captions have no explicit overflow/wrapping rule.
Recovery action container uses flex-wrap and gap-3.

issues.rule: MDC-043 / MDC-044: narrow containers and long translations
issues.detail: No recovery Button opts into the existing wrapLabel contract or maximum allocated width. Button defaults to fixed h-10 and wrapLabel false. Action-row wrapping alone does not establish long-label or 200%-text containment.
issues.fix: Use existing Button wrapLabel and suitable allocated-width classes for recovery actions; exercise long labels and text zoom without dropping any action.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: UNVERIFIED at 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1024, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2560px; allocated-container, RTL and zoom behavior also unverified.

sourceEvidence.detail: Compass and all button icons use aria-hidden=true.
Suggestions nav has a translated accessible label; links have translated labels plus path captions.
Suggestion links include an explicit focus-visible ring, but its color is fixed cyan.
Inherited Heading level=page has tabIndex=-1 and data-route-focus-target; actual focus-manager execution not inspected.

issues.detail: Suggestion Link only adds px-1 with no minimum height or vertical padding. Recovery Buttons inherit md h-10 (Button.tsx:39). The stronger 44px mobile-target default is not explicitly provided; actual geometry and WCAG spacing exceptions are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Give suggestion links and recovery buttons explicit mobile target sizing using existing primitives/classes; retain native links, focus indication and all captions. Measure actual target spacing before asserting compliance.

accessibility.runtimeAcceptance: Keyboard, focus restoration, screen-reader announcements, effective text/UI contrast, forced colors, reduced motion and target geometry UNVERIFIED. No page-authored animation.

states.success: The recovery UI itself is always rendered for this component; matching suggestions are optional supplemental navigation.
states.empty: Zero suggestions hides only the suggestion nav (page:75); heading, unmatched pathname and all three recovery actions remain.
states.error: This is an unmatched-route explanation, not an API error response. No page-owned network failure/retry state.
states.loading: No asynchronous page-owned source or loading branch; route-registry calculation is synchronous.
states.offline: Local explanation and suggestions require no page fetch; destination routes and palette behavior offline remain unverified.
states.partial: No asynchronous partial-data source; absence of suggestions does not hide recovery actions.
states.disabled: Page does not pass disabled/loading to recovery buttons. Palette availability is not checked locally.
states.limits: PageLayout inherits broader operational-mode/announcement behavior through PageContainer; transitive shell/query behavior was not audited. No backend behavior is inferred.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-040: restrained theme-aware navigation
visualIssues.detail: Suggestion text-cyan-300 and focus-visible:ring-cyan-400 hardcode an accent independent of the saved theme/focus tokens. This is fixed saturated-color noise, not evidence of measured contrast failure. Page source has no explicit neon, glow or pure-white classes.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic/theme-aware navigation text and --focus-ring tokens, retaining hover underline, visible focus and route captions. Do not reset saved theme preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: The effect unconditionally logs pathname plus the entire query string via console.warn, despite its comment describing a development aid. URLs can carry sensitive user-supplied values; no development guard or query redaction is present in this source. No actual sensitive URL or production log was observed.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve diagnostic intent through development-only, redacted reporting; avoid logging arbitrary query strings. Retain pathname display and all route-recovery behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: The generated registry includes /dev/grid-states, /dev/layout and /dev/stats without hidden=true. closestRoutes.ts:32 only excludes hidden entries, so these are eligible recovery candidates. Their current mounted availability/guards are unknown; this is an eligibility inconsistency, not a proven broken link.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the registry-generation integration owner define suggestion eligibility for internal/development routes using the existing hidden contract, without removing registered routes, public destinations or aliases.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-030: preserve existing shell action integration
architectureIssues.detail: Open command palette dispatches an event but this page does not establish a listener or availability contract. The source comment mentions both shell-contained and outside-shell mounting; those mounts and listener presence were not independently inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve the existing toggle-command-palette event and verify it on every catch-all mount during integration QA; do not invent a second palette or claim this action is broken from source alone.

priority.rationale: Small synchronous recovery page already uses shared layout, typography, surfaces and buttons. First address arbitrary URL logging; then theme-aware links, mobile/long-label reachability and generated suggestion eligibility. No redesign or new presentation component is justified.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Generated route suggestion eligibility
requiredSharedChanges.ownerEvidence: Generated-file header at routeRegistry.ts:1-4 names the generator; generator implementation was not inspected.
dependsOn: existing frontend route-generation policy; current development-route availability is unverified
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Use the existing generated hidden flag consistently for confirmed development/internal entries. Preserve every registry identity, route, alias, i18n key and suggestion-ranking rule; no new component/API proposal.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Review generator classification with its integration owner and regenerate through the existing tooling if confirmed.

sections.name: Suggested pages with labels and path metadata

actions.name: Suggested destination
actions.behavior: Link to each s.path; translated label and path caption; up to five links

dataBehavior: Display location.pathname as React-escaped translated interpolation; do not replace it with fabricated routes.
Keep memoized pathname-driven closestRoutes call with limit=5 and generated route labels/i18n keys.
Preserve engine normalization, hidden exclusion, threshold=6, distance/path ordering and zero-suggestion behavior.
Preserve all navigation destinations, history fallback, title cleanup, visible metadata and translated accessible names.
Preserve diagnostic purpose while remediating unrestricted query-string logging; diagnostic redaction is not authorization to remove recovery features.
No page-owned API, telemetry values, units, export, vehicle selector or date scope exists; do not introduce them.
No source edit was made by this audit.

evidenceLimits.routeEvidence: routes ['*'] is the exact assignment. Page comment describes two catch-all mounts; App.tsx and actual mounted reachability were not inspected.
